How big may a number be? Three doors with three limits

Type a number. The t27a assembler reads it three ways: as a .word, as an immediate and as a register number. Each door has its own limit, and each refusal has its own name.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
